channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Democrats call for investigation into IRS taxpayer data leak
item.description: Democratic lawmakers demanded a federal investigation after the IRS shared confidential information belonging to 47,000 taxpayers with the Department of Homeland Security.

item.title: Alabama 2026 Legislative Report: Week Five
item.description: Lawmakers advanced 753 bills through the 2026 Regular Session, addressing criminal justice, tax policy, and dredging regulations as budget deliberations continued.

item.title: Opinion | Watergate doesn’t bother me; does your conscience bother you?
item.description: We deserve an honest reckoning with the presidents we excuse and what our selective conscience reveals about our values and moral judgment.

item.title: Opinion | What happens after the press release
item.description: The Alabama Rural Health Transformation Program faces the difficult task of bridging the gap between federal authorization and daily clinical operations.

item.title: Alabama State University to host Montgomery.AI summit in March
item.description: Alabama State University will host a free artificial intelligence summit March 5 to explore how the technology reshapes learning and public service.

item.title: The V: Undecideds surge as money reshapes Alabama’s 2026 races
item.description: Polling volatility, outside spending and structural reforms could redefine Alabama’s Senate, PSC oversight, and economic development landscape in 2026.

item.title: Gov. Ivey encourages Alabamians to take advantage of Severe Weather Preparedness Tax Holiday
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey urged Alabamians to stock up on tax-free emergency supplies from February 20-22 ahead of the upcoming tornado season.

item.title: Opinion | The quiet work of self-government
item.description: How politics became identity, and why seriousness—not slogans—must anchor a functioning democratic republic.

item.title: Opinion | The fish are dying—and I don’t feel so good myself
item.description: We are killing our natural resources. And our conservative lawmakers are actively participating in the criminal acts against them.

item.title: House committee advances bill to ban chemtrails
item.description: Speakers at the public hearing on the bill blamed chemtrails for the flooding of Camp Mystic in Texas last summer.
